verdict.rationale: Bruno documents importing existing Postman collections and even a 'preserve scripts' option for Postman import/export, plus its own portable plain-text .bru format that lives on the filesystem for easy sharing/versioning. However, evidence only covers Postman interoperability and lacks documentation of exporting to other formats (e.g., OpenAPI, Insomnia) or independent confirmation of import fidelity. Missing for 10: explicit export-to-Postman/OpenAPI support, broader multi-tool interoperability, and hands-on community verification of import/export accuracy.
